sn12.11:1.2: ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2
sn12.11:1.3: Cattāro me bhikkhave āhārā bhūtānam vā sattānaṃ ṭhitiyā sambhavesīnam vā anuggahāya ||
sn12.11:1.5: Kabaliṃkāro āhāro oḷāriko vā sukhumo vā || phasso dutiyo || manosañcetanā tatiyo || viññānaṃ catutthaṃ ||
sn12.11:1.6: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro āhārā bhūtānam vā sattānaṃ ṭhitiyā sambhavesīnaṃ vā anuggahāya || || 3
sn12.11:2.1: Ime ca bhikkhave cattāro āhārā kiṃnidānā kiṃ samudayā kiṃjatikā kimpabhavā || ||
sn12.11:2.2: Ime cattāro āhārā taṇhānidānā taṇhāsamudayā taṇhājātikā taṇhāpabhavā || 4
sn12.11:2.3: Taṇhā cāyam bhikkhave kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kimpabhavā ||
sn12.11:2.4: Taṇhā vedanānidānā vedanāsamudayā vedanājātikā vedanā pabhavā || || 5
sn12.11:2.5: Vedanā cāyam bhikkhave kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā || kimpabhavā ||
sn12.11:2.7: Phasso cāyam bhikkhave kiṃnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiṃjātiko kimpabhavo ||
sn12.11:2.9: Saḷāyatanaṃ cidaṃ bhikkhave kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kimpabhāvaṃ ||
sn12.11:2.11: Nāmarūpañcidaṃ bhikkhave kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikam kimpabhavaṃ || ||
sn12.11:2.13: Viññāṇaṃ cidam bhikkhave kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayam kiṃjātikaṃ kimpabhavaṃ ||
sn12.11:2.15: Saṅkhārā cime bhikkhave kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kimpabhavā ||
sn12.11:3.3: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 12
sn12.11:3.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || ||
